column1: # Pinned apps on the waybar (scripts/pinned.sh, pinned-watch.py). One row per app, tab separated; "-" = none. Order = order on the bar.
# After a change run: ~/.config/waybar/scripts/bar.sh reload   (renders the module list and reloads waybar)
#   id          short unique name [a-z0-9]+ (module custom/pin#ID, state file name)
#   label       name in tooltips and menus
#   glyph       Nerd Font icon shown on the bar (icons only: the compact bar stays compact)
#   class       regex for the Hyprland window class (hyprctl clients -j | jq -r '.[].class'), case-insensitive
#   launch      shell command that starts the app or opens a new window (same .desktop entry the rofi launcher runs)
#   notify      regex (case-insensitive, searched) for the notification app_name or desktop-entry hint: such a notification
#               sets the soft "new" highlight until a window of the app gets focus; "-" = never highlighted (YTM sends
#               one notification per track, which is not news)
